Bring a natural, woodland feel to your seasonal styling with this 30cm Christmas Tree Shape Birch Bark Wooden Table Top Decoration. Designed in a tree shape and finished with genuine birch bark, it offers a rustic look that suits festive decorating in living rooms, hallways, dining spaces and other indoor areas. A practical choice for homes that favour rustic Christmas decor, this table top piece works well alongside both classic and contemporary festive themes. The off-white tones of the birch bark blend easily with greenery, candles, lights and other seasonal accessories, helping you create a coordinated display with minimal effort. Because it is freestanding, it can be used on its own as a focal point or combined with other decorations for a fuller arrangement. The size is clearly suited to smaller display areas where a statement decoration is wanted without taking up too much space. At 30cm high, it offers noticeable height while remaining compact enough for everyday home styling during the holidays. The combination of natural texture and simple form makes it an appealing decorative feature for Christmas entertaining or quiet seasonal displays. This birch bark table top decoration also makes a thoughtful gift idea for family or friends who enjoy nature-inspired festive styling. Its charming tree-shaped design symbolises the season in an understated way, making it suitable for gifting as well as personal use. Whether placed on a shelf beside existing decor or used as part of a centrepiece, it adds a calm, cosy feel to your Christmas setting. Easy to position and simple to enjoy year after year, this wooden decoration offers a tasteful way to bring seasonal character into the home. It combines rustic style with festive detail in one freestanding design that feels both traditional and distinctive.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Slim 6ft design is ideal when you want a taller festive feature without using too much floor space; suitable for corners, hallways and smaller rooms where a full-width tree may feel too large.
- Pre-lit styling helps reduce the time needed to prepare your display and gives you a ready-made base for further decorating with baubles, ribbon or other seasonal accessories of your choice.
- Green finish creates a traditional Christmas look that works well with both classic colour schemes and modern decorative themes, making it easy to match your existing home décor.
- PVC material provides an artificial branch effect designed for repeated seasonal use, offering a practical option that can be stored away after Christmas and brought out again next year.
- Indoor decorative tree is useful as part of your festive home setup; place on a stable level surface and keep away from heat sources while decorating to help maintain safe use throughout the season.
- Metal Base
- Cool White Leds

## Information
Bring a timeless festive look into your home with this 6ft pre-lit slim green Christmas tree. Designed for indoor seasonal decorating, it offers a classic Christmas centrepiece without taking up as much floor space as a fuller tree, making it a practical choice for living rooms, hallways, apartments and other smaller areas where space needs to be used carefully. The slim shape helps create a neat silhouette that is easy to position in corners or beside furniture, while the green finish gives a traditional Christmas appearance. With pre-lit styling included in the product type, this tree is intended to simplify seasonal setup and help you create an inviting display more quickly. It can be dressed further with baubles, ribbon, garlands and other decorations to suit your chosen theme. Made with PVC material, the tree is designed to provide a decorative artificial branch effect suitable for repeated use across the festive season. Artificial trees can be a convenient alternative to real trees because they do not shed needles in the same way and can be stored away after use ready for the next year. This makes them useful for customers looking for a practical indoor decoration that supports straightforward annual reuse. Its slim profile also makes it suitable where you want height and presence without an oversized footprint. Whether you are creating a simple family display or building a more elaborate festive scene, this tree offers a versatile base for your Christmas decorating ideas. The neutral green colour works well with traditional red and gold schemes as well as modern silver, white or natural woodland-inspired themes. Before assembly or decorating, check the available space and ensure the tree is positioned safely on a level surface away from heat sources such as radiators, fires or candles. If using additional lights or ornaments, follow the manufacturer guidance supplied with those accessories. This 6ft pre-lit slim green Christmas tree provides an easy way to add seasonal style with a balanced design that suits many indoor settings.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Slim pencil design helps save floor space, making the tree suitable for narrow rooms, entrances and compact display areas.
- The 8ft height creates a noticeable festive feature while the narrow profile suits smaller spaces and busy interiors.
- PVC construction provides a lightweight feel for easier moving, positioning and decorating during setup.
- Pointed tips add a neat decorative finish for an attractive seasonal display once assembled.
- Folds away after use for convenient storage and repeated seasonal decorating.
- Pop-up artificial Christmas tree with a sturdy foldable metal stand included.
- Flocked green finish creates a wintry seasonal look without real needles or watering.
- Easy to assemble, with the tree ready for display in minutes.
- Densely packed folding branches create a fuller-looking display.
- Fire-retardant construction supports safer seasonal decorating.

## Information
Create a festive display with this 8ft green artificial flocked slim pencil Christmas tree from Shatchi. Its narrow profile suits homes, offices, shops and other indoor spaces where floor area is limited, while the tall design creates a noticeable seasonal feature. Made from PVC, the tree is lightweight and easy to handle during setup and decorating. Pointed tips and a flocked finish provide a neat, wintry appearance, while the densely packed folding branches create a fuller-looking display. The included metal stand supports stable placement, and the tree folds away after use for convenient storage between occasions. Partial assembly is required. Not suitable for children under 36 months.

## Information
Add a festive focal point to your home with this green wooden Christmas tabletop decoration. Designed to create a rich seasonal atmosphere, it works well as a decorative centrepiece for living rooms, hallways, dining areas or other indoor display spaces. The traditional look is enhanced with pine and berry detail, giving the piece a classic Christmas feel that suits both modern and more traditional interiors. This standing decoration is battery operated for flexible placement, so it can be positioned where you want seasonal light without needing a mains connection. It uses 12 small warm white LED bulbs with a steady light effect and no flashing, helping to create a gentle glow for evening displays. The lights are described as warm white, making them suitable for adding subtle decoration rather than harsh brightness. Made from high-quality wooden material, the decoration is described as safe, durable and eco-friendly. Its green finish helps it blend naturally into festive arrangements while still standing out as a seasonal feature. At 42cm in size, it offers a noticeable presence without taking up too much space, making it practical for tabletops, shelves, mantelpieces or sideboards. The product requires 3 x AA batteries, which are not included. That makes it easy to place in different parts of the home without cables getting in the way. As a single-piece decoration, it can be used on its own or combined with other Christmas decorations to build a coordinated display. If you are looking for an elegant indoor festive accent, this wooden tabletop decoration offers a simple way to bring warmth and seasonal character into your home. The combination of green colour, pine and berry detail, and steady LED lighting creates a welcoming decorative piece for Christmas displays throughout the season.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Compact 4ft size makes this artificial Christmas tree suitable for smaller rooms, tabletops, corners and other indoor spaces where a larger tree may not fit comfortably during the festive season.
- Black finish gives a modern decorative look and creates a strong backdrop for baubles, ribbons and lights, helping you build a personalised Christmas display that suits your chosen style.
- Made from PVC material for seasonal decorative use, offering an artificial alternative that can be packed away after Christmas and brought out again for future indoor displays.
- Ideal for home or office decorating when you want something different from a traditional green tree, with plenty of scope to style it simply or make it the focus of your festive theme.
- A practical base for indoor Christmas décor that can be dressed with your own ornaments and lights; always follow safe installation guidance when adding electrical decorations.

## Information
Create a striking seasonal display with this 4ft black artificial Christmas tree, designed for indoor decorative use in the home, office or retail-style settings. The black finish offers a modern alternative to a traditional green tree and provides a bold backdrop for baubles, ribbons, lights and other festive decorations. With a compact 4ft size, it is well suited to smaller rooms, tabletops, corners or spaces where a full-size tree may not be practical. Made from PVC, this artificial tree is intended for repeated seasonal use and offers a convenient option for customers who want an easy-to-set-up decorative tree without the need for watering or needle clean-up. Its artificial construction makes it suitable for creating a consistent look year after year, while the neutral structure allows you to personalise the final display to suit your chosen theme. This product is ideal for customers looking to add something different to their Christmas décor. The black colour can work especially well with metallic accents, bright ornaments or monochrome styling, helping create a contemporary festive feature. Because the tree is artificial, it can be packed away after use and brought out again for future celebrations. Use this tree as part of your Christmas decorating scheme in living rooms, hallways, reception areas or display spaces. It can be styled simply for a minimal look or dressed more fully for a fuller festive centrepiece. As with all decorative items, care should be taken when adding lights and ornaments so that they are used safely and appropriately indoors. The compact format makes it suitable where floor space is limited but you still want an eye-catching seasonal feature. Whether used on its own or as part of a wider Christmas display, this black artificial tree provides a versatile base for festive styling and decoration.

## Features
- 90 cm tabletop size for flexible seasonal placement

- Santa inspired design captures a playful character

## Information
Bring playful Christmas cheer to your holiday decorating!This mini tabletop Christmas tree combines seasonal greenery, cheerful Santa details, and inviting illumination in a compact format that brings personality to your festive arrangement. Compact and easy to reposition, this small realistic Christmas tree fits neatly on entry tables, mantels, office desks, and other limited surfaces. Note: Battery box requires 3 AA batteries, not included.Note: The decorations are not included.

## Features
- 720 branch tips with realistic PVC leaves
- 39 natural pine cones add authentic rustic holiday charm
- Frost-tipped foliage for soft wintry festive styling
- Slim pencil shape for space-saving compact placement

## Information
Spruce up your holiday interior with the snow-kissed evergreen holiday tree for magical winter-themed celebrations.Showcasing 720 dense branch tips and 39 natural pine cones, this artificial Christmas tree carries delightful woodland vibes through its snow-frosted foliage and layered natural-looking outline to become a gorgeous holiday focal point. Its slim pencil-style outline works wonderfully for cramped corners and small nooks, infusing wintry festive spirit without taking up too much floor room. Designed with user-friendly hinged branches, a sturdy folding metal stand, protective foot pads and matching assembly gloves, it allows for fast, tool-free setup and stable placement, letting you spend less time assembling and more time embracing festive joy. Crafted from premium PVC material, it holds up for year-round holiday use, featuring flame-retardant, anti-fading, non-allergic and smell-less qualities for reliable everyday use. Flexible enough for cosy home nights, lively parties and retail seasonal showcases alike, it breathes warm Christmas atmosphere into every spot you place it. Note: Ornaments are not included.

A timer function adds everyday convenience and helps manage your lighting routine during the festive period. The tree is made from PVC for a practical artificial finish that is easy to handle and assemble. Its lightweight construction makes it straightforward to position in the home and simple to store away after the season. This makes it a useful choice for those who want a decorative tree with flexible lighting controls but without taking up too much room. The compact design works well as part of a larger Christmas display or as a standalone feature in smaller settings. Whether placed in a living room corner, hallway, office or sheltered outdoor space, it provides an attractive seasonal accent with useful control features built in. For customers looking for an artificial Christmas tree that combines convenience with decorative appeal, this 4ft fibre optic option offers a practical balance of style and ease of use. It is suitable for creating a welcoming festive atmosphere while keeping setup simple and storage manageable once celebrations are over.

## Information
The artificial Christmas tree Cupid from tectake is the perfect choice for any home looking to enhance their festive spirit. With the trees rich green colour, it brings a cosy atmosphere to your living room. Thanks to the use of injection moulding and PVC needles, the artificial Christmas tree looks particularly realistic. In the injection moulding process, the needles are made three-dimensionally and precisely mimic real fir needles. The tree trunk with its wooden appearance enhances the realistic look and gives your Christmas tree an authentic look, making every room shine in festive splendour. A real advantage of an artificial Christmas tree is its ease of care. You don't have to worry about drying out or annoying needle loss, as is the case with real trees. It remains in perfect shape throughout the Christmas season and can be reused every year. This makes it a particularly sustainable solution for the holidays. With the innovative plug-in mechanism, the artificial pine tree can be effortlessly set up in just a few minutes. This leaves more time to add your favourite lights and best decorations so you can truly get into the Christmas spirit. The stable tree stand provides secure support and after the festive season, the Christmas tree can be dismantled into its individual parts and stored compactly. Opt for the artificial Christmas tree Cupid from tectake and enjoy a worry-free festive season in your home, without having to forgo the charm of a natural tree!

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Blends thick PE leaves and lifelike PVC foliage
- Bring dreamy winter magic inside with this tree
- Soft warm white glow emanates from this pre lit tree

## Information
Create a snow-kissed festive centerpiece for your home with this full-bodied flocked Christmas tree.Loaded with 387/591 lush branch tips, blended PE and PVC foliage and 23/29 natural pine cones , it serves as a lush and eye-catching holiday focal display. The entire tree is finely coated with delicate white flocking, recreating a vivid snow-laden winter scene. Flocked tree care: a little flocking may shed during first setup, gentle handling works best! In addition, it emits soft diffused warm illumination via 140/190 warm white LEDs, with hidden wires for a natural look and a UL certified adapter ensuring safe, stable power output. Designed with a user-friendly 2/2-section hinged structure and folding metal stand, it supports quick assembly and easy storage, while the matched gloves allow easy branch fluffing and shaping. Crafted from 100% new PE and PVC materials, the tree features outstanding fade resistance, flame-retardant, allergy-proof and smell-free traits, maintaining its full, snowy vibrant appearance for repeated holiday use with zero decorating worries. Note: Ornaments are not included.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Elegant woodland charm
- Natural-looking pe and pvc tips
- Hinged branch construction
- Green metal stand included
- Easy to assemble

## Information
Bring timeless festive charm into your home with the Christow Nordmann Fir Artificial Tree. Designed with a classic tapered silhouette, the Nordmann Fir features a blend of lifelike PE and PVC tips for a dense, natural look. The branches are crafted to capture the character of a real fir, providing plenty of space to hang lights, baubles, and your favourite festive decorations. Pre-attached hinged branches make the Nordmann Fir quick and easy to assemble. Simply slot the poles together, allow the branches to fall into place, then gently fluff them up for a natural shape. Strong and sturdy, the branches provide ample support for lights and ornaments. Each tree comes with a heavy-duty dark green metal stand that blends seamlessly with the lower branches for a stylish, cohesive look. Silver metal eyebolts help keep the tree sturdy and secure, while rubber feet add grip on smooth floors and protect them from marks and scratches. Delivered in a sturdy box with protective caps on each pole, the Verbier Fir is simple to put together. Secure the base section into the stand, slot in the other sections, and allow the branches to drop. Once the season ends, it can be easily disassembled for compact storage until the following Christmas.

## Features
- Artificial Christmas tree in rich green with plenty of volume
- Realistic appearance thanks to detailed injection moulded needles
- Quick assembly and disassembly in the plug-in system
- Stable, foldable tree stand made of powder-coated steel with floor-friendly plastic feet
- Particularly low-maintenance

## Information
The artificial Christmas tree Prancer by tectake is the perfect choice to immerse your home in a cosy, festive atmosphere. The trees rich green and lifelike injection-moulded needles give it a realistic appearance that rivals a real fir tree. The accurately crafted branches offer ample space for all your favourite decorations, from classic baubles to sparkling lights. Thanks to the robust stand made of powder-coated steel, the artificial Christmas tree offers absolute stability even with fully laden branches. The plastic feet on the stand prevent scratches on delicate floors and ensure stability on any surface. Particularly practical: The plug-in mechanism allows for effortless assembly of the Christmas tree with just a few simple steps, without the need for additional tools. Afterwards, you can bend and shape the branches as you wish, and add your best decorations. You don't have to worry about falling needles or watering, as the artificial Christmas tree always remains in splendid form. Made from particularly durable and high-quality materials, this eye-catcher lasts for many years. It is therefore the ideal choice for all those who do not want the hassle of a real tree. After the holidays, the artificial tree can be easily dismantled into its individual parts and stored compactly. This way, it takes up little space and waits to shine in full glory again next year. With the artificial Christmas tree Prancer by tectake, you bring the magic of Christmas into your home!

## Information
Designed to bring festive grandeur to rooms with high ceilings, this Christow Fraser Fir Christmas Tree stands a majestic 10ft tall and is ideal for spacious homes, entrance halls, and lobbies. Its 2,531 PE and PVC tips create a full, richly layered shape with abundant space for lights and decorations, while its five-section design and hinged branches make it easy to assemble and display. Measuring 165cm in diameter, its carefully proportioned silhouette provides a substantial display while preserving valuable room around the base. products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Available in sizes 2ft, 3ft, 4ft, 6ft and 7ft
- Indoor use only
- Colour-changing fibre optics
- Includes a star topper with LEDs
- Sparkle baubles provided
- 1.8m black cable
- PLEASE NOTE - THIS TREE DOES NOT COME WITH A REMOTE CONTROL
- Timer included: 8hrs on/16hrs off

## Information
The images on show are of our actual tree. Even with meticulous wrapping, each tree needs to be assembled correctly to get the desired look. First, assemble the tree foundation and then (if needed) install the lower section. Extend the branches of the upper portion down until you discover the electrical connection point. After the connection is completed, make sure the upper and lower electrical connections are in place before putting the top section of the tree into the lower pole (because 2ft, 3ft, and 4ft trees are all one-piece, this step is not required). Fold the first layer of branches just above horizontal form, working your way up from the base of the tree; this should give the branches a narrow \"V\" shape. Once you reach the top layer of your tree, repeat these steps for the remaining tiers. Before you plug in your tree, attach any ornaments or other decorations it may have! If gaps are evident from different angles, raising the back branches relative to the front branches may help. This fills in the \"visual gaps\" without sacrificing the appearance of layers. Work your way down the tree, starting at the top, to disassemble it. Available here as a 2ft (60cm) tree.

Whether used as a main feature in a smaller room or as an additional decorative accent elsewhere in the home, it offers a convenient and colorful way to celebrate the season. The design is also suitable where families want a decorative tree that can be positioned safely indoors alongside everyday household activity. Its artificial format avoids shedding needles and supports tidy seasonal decorating, while the pre-lit effect adds visual interest straight away. With its compact size and simple operation, this 3ft fiber optic Christmas tree provides an attractive festive option that balances style, convenience and repeat use across many Christmas seasons.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Pre-lit Alaskan pine with warm white LEDs
- Durable, fireproof PVC branches
- 8 lighting modes for festive ambience
- Full, natural look for small spaces
- Stable metal stand for sec
- Compact 4ft size makes this pre-lit artificial Christmas tree a practical choice for smaller rooms, flats or office spaces where you still want a traditional festive centrepiece without taking up too much floor area.
- Warm white lights help create an inviting Christmas atmosphere straight away, reducing the need for extra string lights and making it quicker to set up your seasonal display indoors.
- PVC branch material gives you a reusable artificial tree option that can be brought out each year, offering an easy way to enjoy festive decorating without the upkeep of a natural tree.
- Pre-lit design saves time during setup and makes decorating simpler, so you can focus on adding baubles, ribbons or other finishing touches to suit your home style.
- Suitable for indoor seasonal use as part of your Christmas décor, this tree can be placed in corners, hallways or living spaces to add height and festive character where space is limited.

## Information
Bring a refined festive feel to your home with this 8ft green pre-lit artificial Alaskan pine Christmas tree. Designed for medium to large sized rooms, it offers a cosy seasonal centrepiece with a natural-looking style and a soft warm white glow. The pre-lit design helps reduce the time spent on decorating, making Christmas preparation simpler and more convenient while still delivering an elegant result. This tree is made with PVC and metal construction for a practical reusable decoration that can be brought out year after year. The hinged construction is designed to help the branches settle into place during assembly, supporting a fuller and more organised appearance once set up. A metal stand is included to provide stable support for indoor display throughout the festive season. The tree includes 320 warm white LEDs, giving you plenty of light coverage for a welcoming finish. With 8 lighting modes available, you can select the effect that best suits your room or occasion. Options include waves, sequential, slogs, chasing/flash, slow fade, twinkle/flash, steady on and combination settings, allowing you to create different moods without needing separate lighting accessories. With around 1100 tips and an approximate width of 140 cm, this artificial Christmas tree is intended to create a full seasonal look while remaining suitable for homes where space is limited. Its green colour and Alaskan pine styling give it a classic festive appearance that works well in many interior settings. The wrapped construction helps support the branch structure as part of the assembly process, while the overall design focuses on ease of use and decorative impact. If you want an attractive indoor Christmas tree that combines convenience with traditional style, this 8ft pre-lit option offers an easy way to add sparkle to your festive décor. It is suitable for shoppers looking for a reusable artificial tree with built-in lights, multiple lighting modes and a sturdy metal stand included. The warm white LEDs give the tree a soft illuminated finish that feels inviting in living rooms, dining spaces or other indoor areas used for seasonal displays. Because the lights are already fitted, there is no need to add separate string lights before decorating. This makes setup quicker and helps keep the overall look neat and coordinated from top to bottom. Its artificial PVC needle construction offers a practical alternative to real trees for customers who prefer something reusable and easier to manage each year. The hinged sections are designed to make assembly straightforward so you can spend less time setting up and more time enjoying your festive decorations. Once assembled, the tree provides a generous silhouette that suits both traditional and contemporary Christmas themes. The selectable light settings add flexibility if you like to change the atmosphere across different times of day or different gatherings during the season. You can choose a subtle steady glow or try more animated effects such as twinkle or chasing styles depending on your preference. This versatility makes it easier to tailor the display without changing any other decorations. Overall, this green 8ft pre-lit artificial Christmas tree combines size, lighting choice and practical construction in one decorative centrepiece. It is an appealing option for anyone wanting an easy-to-assemble indoor tree with warm white LEDs already included.
Bring a touch of holiday spirit with this pre-lit WWarm Alaskan Pine Cristmas Tree tree, perfect for creating a warm and festive atmosphere in your home.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Available in sizes 2ft, 3ft, 4ft, 6ft and 7ft
- Indoor use only
- Colour-changing fibre optics
- Includes a star topper with LEDs
- Sparkle baubles provided
- 1.8m black cable
- PLEASE NOTE - THIS TREE DOES NOT COME WITH A REMOTE CONTROL
- Timer included: 8hrs on/16hrs off

## Information
The images on show are of our real trees. Even with meticulous wrapping, each tree needs to be assembled correctly to get the desired look. First, assemble the tree foundation and then (if needed) install the lower section. Extend the branches of the upper portion down until you discover the electrical connection point. After the connection is completed, make sure the upper and lower electrical connections are in place before putting the top section of the tree into the lower pole (because 2ft, 3ft, and 4ft trees are all one-piece, this step is not required). Fold the first layer of branches just above horizontal form, working your way up from the base of the tree; this should give the branches a narrow \"V\" shape. Once you reach the top layer of your tree, repeat these steps for the remaining tiers. Before you plug in your tree, attach any ornaments or other decorations it may have! If gaps are evident from different angles, raising the back branches relative to the front branches may help. This fills in the \"visual gaps\" without sacrificing the appearance of layers. Work your way down the tree, starting at the top, to disassemble it. Available here as a 3ft (90cm) tree.

## Features
- 3ft size suits compact festive displays
- Cool white LEDs create a crisp winter look
- Plug-in design makes setup quick and simple
- Flat base helps keep the tree standing neatly
- PVC build allows reuse across many seasons

## Information
Bring a clean, contemporary festive look to your home or garden with this 3ft pre-lit artificial twig Christmas tree. The modern twig-style design is paired with cool white LED lights to create a bright decorative feature for Christmas displays and seasonal styling. It is a practical choice for those looking for an easy-to-use decoration that can be brought out year after year. This tree is designed for straightforward use: simply plug it in and the lights come on. That makes it suitable when you want a quick seasonal display without complicated setup. The flat base helps the tree stand neatly in place, while the PVC construction offers a durable artificial finish that can be assembled, stored and reused for future celebrations. At 3ft high, this tree works well where space is limited or where a smaller feature display is preferred. It can suit living rooms, hallways, porches, sheltered outdoor areas and other decorative settings where a compact illuminated tree adds atmosphere. The white finish and cool white LEDs provide a crisp look that fits both traditional and modern Christmas themes. Home assembly is required, giving you the flexibility to set up the display where you need it most. The transformer should be kept plugged indoors at all times, so it is important to position the product accordingly when decorating sheltered outdoor spaces. With its simple plug-in operation and reusable design, this artificial twig tree offers an easy way to create a festive focal point without ongoing maintenance. Its lightweight decorative style makes it suitable for seasonal home styling as well as event decor where a neat illuminated feature is needed. Whether used on its own or as part of a larger Christmas arrangement, this pre-lit twig tree delivers a clear winter display with minimal effort. The combination of PVC material, flat base support and cool white lighting makes it a versatile addition to festive decorations. For households wanting an attractive alternative to traditional foliage, this artificial twig tree provides a clean silhouette and reliable seasonal appeal. It is intended as a decorative piece rather than a natural-looking fir or pine style tree, making it ideal for modern interiors or themed displays. Because it can be folded, stored and reused between seasons, it also offers practical value for repeat use during Christmas celebrations each year.
Bring a touch of holiday spirit with this pre-lit Twig LEDs tree, perfect for creating a warm and festive atmosphere in your home.

## Information
Bring a neat festive look to your home with this 6ft slim pre-lit artificial pencil Christmas tree. The narrow profile is designed for spaces where a fuller tree may feel too wide, making it suitable for hallways, corners and other areas where you want seasonal decoration without taking up much room. Densely packed folding branches help create an attractive display with very little shaping or arranging, so setup is quick and straightforward. This artificial Christmas tree is finished in green and uses a wrapped construction with PVC tips and a metal stand. The combination of materials gives it a practical seasonal design that can be used again year after year. Because the branches fold neatly, the tree is easier to store when the season ends and simpler to bring out again for future celebrations. It is erected in minutes, which makes it a convenient option for busy households that want an instant decorative centrepiece without lengthy assembly. The tree is pre-lit with cool white LEDs, providing an illuminated festive effect without the need to add separate lights. This helps save time when decorating and creates a bright, consistent look once switched on. With 430 tips and 180 LEDs, it offers plenty of visual detail while keeping the slim pencil shape that works well in smaller rooms or more compact display areas. At 6ft tall, this tree offers a noticeable presence while remaining manageable for indoor decorating. The size is measured from top to bottom including the stand, helping you choose with confidence when planning your layout. Its 58cm width supports the slim profile, making it a practical choice where floor space is limited but you still want a classic Christmas tree appearance. Designed for decorative display, this pre-lit artificial tree suits home use as well as seasonal events and sheltered outdoor occasions where appropriate. It can also work well for themed decor, celebrations and event styling. The simple folding branch design makes it easy to store between uses, while the reusable construction supports repeated seasonal decorating. If you want a tidy festive centerpiece that combines convenience with an instant lighted finish, this slim pencil Christmas tree offers a straightforward solution for creating an inviting holiday display.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Available in sizes 2ft, 3ft, 4ft, 6ft and 7ft
- Indoor use only
- Colour-changing fibre optics
- Includes a star topper with LEDs
- Sparkle baubles provided
- 1.8m black cable
- PLEASE NOTE - THIS TREE DOES NOT COME WITH A REMOTE CONTROL
- Timer included: 8hrs on/16hrs off

## Information
The images on show are of our real trees. Even with meticulous wrapping, each tree needs to be assembled correctly to get the desired look. First, assemble the tree foundation and then (if needed) install the lower section. Extend the branches of the upper portion down until you discover the electrical connection point. After the connection is completed, make sure the upper and lower electrical connections are in place before putting the top section of the tree into the lower pole (because 2ft, 3ft, and 4ft trees are all one-piece, this step is not required). Fold the first layer of branches just above horizontal form, working your way up from the base of the tree; this should give the branches a narrow \"V\" shape. Once you reach the top layer of your tree, repeat these steps for the remaining tiers. Before you plug in your tree, attach any ornaments or other decorations it may have! If gaps are evident from different angles, raising the back branches relative to the front branches may help. This fills in the \"visual gaps\" without sacrificing the appearance of layers. Work your way down the tree, starting at the top, to disassemble it. Available here as a 4ft (120cm) tree.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Available in sizes 2ft, 3ft, 4ft, 6ft and 7ft
- Indoor use only
- Colour-changing fibre optics
- Includes a star topper with LEDs
- Sparkle baubles provided
- 1.8m black cable
- PLEASE NOTE - THIS TREE DOES NOT COME WITH A REMOTE CONTROL
- Timer included: 8hrs on/16hrs off

## Information
The images on show are of our real trees. Even with meticulous wrapping, each tree needs to be assembled correctly to get the desired look. First, assemble the tree foundation and then (if needed) install the lower section. Extend the branches of the upper portion down until you discover the electrical connection point. After the connection is completed, make sure the upper and lower electrical connections are in place before putting the top section of the tree into the lower pole (because 2ft, 3ft, and 4ft trees are all one-piece, this step is not required). Fold the first layer of branches just above horizontal form, working your way up from the base of the tree; this should give the branches a narrow \"V\" shape. Once you reach the top layer of your tree, repeat these steps for the remaining tiers. Before you plug in your tree, attach any ornaments or other decorations it may have! If gaps are evident from different angles, raising the back branches relative to the front branches may help. This fills in the \"visual gaps\" without sacrificing the appearance of layers. Work your way down the tree, starting at the top, to disassemble it. Available here as a 5ft (150cm) tree.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Pre-Lit Halden Fir Christmas Tree with a sparse, natural look
- Available in 5ft and 6ft sizes with 72 / 85 realistic PE tips
- 240 / 300 static warm white micro LEDs with timer function
- UK mains powered with 5m cable for flexible display
- 4 U-shaped ground stakes included for outdoor stability

## Information
Add a touch of festive elegance to your home with this Pre-Lit Halden Fir Sparse Artificial Christmas Tree. Available in 5ft and 6ft sizes, its slender shape and sparse, Scandi-inspired silhouette make it a beautiful choice for modern interiors. Lightly flocked branches create a frosted winter look, while static warm white micro LEDs cast a soft festive glow to create an enchanting Christmas display. Warm White Micro LEDs Beautifully illuminated by 240 / 300 static warm white micro LEDs, the tree adds a soft festive glow to any setting. Smaller than standard LEDs, they allow the silhouette of the tree to shine through while looking stunning when switched off. Built-In Timer Function Enjoy hassle-free festive lighting with a built-in timer function. Once activated, the tree automatically lights up at the same time each evening before switching off six hours later. You can also manually switch the lights on and off. Indoor Plug with 5m Cable Powered by an IP20-rated UK transformer plug for indoor sockets only. With a generous 5m length, the cable gives you plenty of flexibility to display the tree in a sheltered outdoor location while plugging it into an indoor socket. Easy Assembly, Simple Styling Designed with twist-together poles, a screw-on base, and flexible branches for easy shaping and assembly. The textured base has a snow-flocked finish, while four U-shaped ground stakes help keep it secure when displayed outside. ## Information
Bring a classic festive feel to your home with this 4ft Pre-lit Green Helsinki Christmas Tree. Designed for seasonal decoration, it features a traditional green finish and built-in warm white LED lights to create a welcoming glow without the need for separate light strings. The tree is made from PVC for a practical artificial finish that can be reused year after year, making it a convenient choice for Christmas decorating indoors. This tree is supplied in a compact 4ft size, making it suitable for smaller rooms, hallways, offices or as an additional decorative feature alongside larger displays. This artificial Christmas tree is intended for indoor decoration and can help transform living spaces into a cheerful winter display. It is suitable for customers looking for a pre-lit option with a natural-looking green finish, practical assembly features and reliable support from the included stand. As with all indoor electrical decorations, the transformer should remain plugged indoors at all times during use. With its combination of pre-lit convenience, PVC construction and compact height, this Helsinki tree offers an easy way to create a festive focal point. It suits homes that need an attractive Christmas tree without the upkeep of real foliage, while still delivering a warm seasonal atmosphere through its integrated lighting and simple design.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- 118 RGB LEDs create a colourful festive display across 12 cascading light strands, finished with a bright 10-LED star topper for a distinctive Christmas tree effect.

## Information
Transform your Christmas display with the Pegdev 2.1m RGB LED Star Tree Light, designed to create an eye-catching tree-shaped feature filled with colour and movement. Twelve cascading light strands flow down from the illuminated star topper, with 118 colour-changing LEDs creating a bright festive display for your home or garden. Choose colours, lighting effects and different modes using the included controller or compatible smartphone app, making it easy to change the appearance of your display throughout the Christmas season. From colourful animated effects to a decorative festive glow, the lighting can be adjusted to complement your chosen Christmas theme. Suitable for creating a standout feature in living spaces, entrance areas, gardens and patios, the 1.2m design provides plenty of visual impact without requiring the space of a full-sized Christmas tree. The sturdy base helps support the tree-shaped display, while the supplied BS IP20 transformer provides mains-powered operation. Ideal as a standalone Christmas decoration or as part of a larger festive lighting display, this RGB LED Star Tree brings together colourful illumination, smart control and an impressive cascading design for an easy way to brighten your seasonal décor.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Available in sizes 2ft, 3ft, 4ft, 6ft and 7ft
- Indoor use only
- Colour-changing fibre optics
- Includes a star topper with LEDs
- Sparkle baubles provided
- 1.8m black cable
- PLEASE NOTE - THIS TREE DOES NOT COME WITH A REMOTE CONTROL
- Timer included: 8hrs on/16hrs off

## Information
The images on show are of our real trees. Even with meticulous wrapping, each tree needs to be assembled correctly to get the desired look. First, assemble the tree foundation and then (if needed) install the lower section. Extend the branches of the upper portion down until you discover the electrical connection point. After the connection is completed, make sure the upper and lower electrical connections are in place before putting the top section of the tree into the lower pole (because 2ft, 3ft, and 4ft trees are all one-piece, this step is not required). Fold the first layer of branches just above horizontal form, working your way up from the base of the tree; this should give the branches a narrow \"V\" shape. Once you reach the top layer of your tree, repeat these steps for the remaining tiers. Before you plug in your tree, attach any ornaments or other decorations it may have! If gaps are evident from different angles, raising the back branches relative to the front branches may help. This fills in the \"visual gaps\" without sacrificing the appearance of layers. Work your way down the tree, starting at the top, to disassemble it. Available here as a 6ft (180cm) tree.

Our Richmond Fir is a traditional Christmas tree for any living room, grand hallway or shop display. Key features 9 lighting modes with remote control — warm white, multicolour, or combined effects in steady, fade, flash, and alternating patterns Dual-colour LED lights, pre-lit with no extra wiring needed to connect sections Full, lifelike hinged branches for quick assembly and a traditional Christmas look Sturdy stand for lasting, stable everyday use What's included 1 x pre-lit Richmond Fir Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x Storage Bag 1 x Remote control Dimensions 6ft: approx. 180cm height, approx. 100cm at base, 798 branch tips 7ft: approx. 210cm height, approx. 125cm at base, 1,098 branch tips Good to know Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery Covered by a 1-year manufacturer warranty FAQs Does it need assembly? Simple assembly required — the tree sections connect together (with built-in power sockets linking the lights automatically) and attach to the stand with 3 hand-tightened bolts, no power tools needed. Once assembled, gently spread out the branches and tips to shape your tree. What lighting modes does it have? The tree features 9 modes via the included remote: steady, fading, and flashing effects in warm white, multicolour, or both combined — plus an alternating mode. How are the lights powered? For best results and safety, display in a dry, sheltered location. Safety Information For indoor use only. Do not use if damaged or wet. Unplug by grasping the plug, not the cord. products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Available in sizes 2ft, 3ft, 4ft, 6ft and 7ft
- Indoor use only
- Colour-changing fibre optics
- Includes a star topper with LEDs
- Sparkle baubles provided
- 1.8m black cable
- PLEASE NOTE - THIS TREE DOES NOT COME WITH A REMOTE CONTROL
- Timer included: 8hrs on/16hrs off

## Information
The images on show are of our real trees. Even with meticulous wrapping, each tree needs to be assembled correctly to get the desired look. First, assemble the tree foundation and then (if needed) install the lower section. Extend the branches of the upper portion down until you discover the electrical connection point. After the connection is completed, make sure the upper and lower electrical connections are in place before putting the top section of the tree into the lower pole (because 2ft, 3ft, and 4ft trees are all one-piece, this step is not required). Fold the first layer of branches just above horizontal form, working your way up from the base of the tree; this should give the branches a narrow \"V\" shape. Once you reach the top layer of your tree, repeat these steps for the remaining tiers. Before you plug in your tree, attach any ornaments or other decorations it may have! If gaps are evident from different angles, raising the back branches relative to the front branches may help. This fills in the \"visual gaps\" without sacrificing the appearance of layers. Work your way down the tree, starting at the top, to disassemble it. Available here as a 7ft (210cm) tree.

## Features
- Starburst Christmas Tree with static warm white micro LEDs
- Available in 1.5m and 1.8m sizes with 1200 / 1600 LEDs
- Built-in timer function (6 hours on / 18 hours off)
- UK mains powered with 5m cable for flexible positioning

## Information
Create a spectacular festive centrepiece with this Christow Micro LED Starburst Christmas Tree. Finished in gold and illuminated by hundreds of static warm white micro LEDs, it has a stunning starburst look for an enchanting light display. Available in 1.5m and 1.8m sizes, it's perfect for adding a magical festive glow to your home, garden, porch, or driveway. Starry Warm White Micro LEDs Coloured gold and illuminated by hundreds of warm white micro LEDs, the tree has a magical starburst look to brighten any setting. Smaller than standard LEDs, the micro LEDs allow the full silhouette of the tree to shine through for a more magical display. Built-In Timer Function Enjoy hassle-free festive lighting every evening with a built-in timer function. Once activated at your desired time, the tree automatically lights up at the same time each day before conveniently switching off six hours later, helping to save energy and reduce effort. Mains Powered with 5m Cable Powered by an IP20-rated UK transformer plug, the tree is suitable for plugging into an indoor socket only. A generous 5m cable gives you plenty of flexibility to place it outside while conveniently plugging it in indoors, making it perfect for a front lawn display. Easy Assembly & Outdoor Stability Simply twist the bottom pole onto the base, then twist the top pole onto the bottom pole to assemble the tree. Flexible branches can be carefully arranged to create a full starburst silhouette, while ground stakes help keep the base secure when displayed outdoors. - 8 lighting modes for any mood

## Information
Bring the magic of christmas into your home with this stunning pre-lit pvc christmas tree. Standing at a classic height with seven lush layers and nearly eight hundred branch tips, this beautifully full tree creates the perfect festive focal point for any living space. Made from high-quality pvc with a sturdy steel pole and a robust iron stand, this tree stays securely in place. The low-voltage mains adapter ensures safe use around children and pets. With its hinged branch design, assembly takes just minutes and storage is equally effortless.

## Information
Create a cosy, elegant atmosphere with this beautiful 9ft Warm White LED Twig Christmas Tree. Featuring 216 static warm white LEDs on a stylish white PVC frame, this decorative tree adds a soft ambient glow to any room. Designed for easy everyday use, the tree includes a convenient built-in timer to light up your tree every day automatically (8 hours on/16 hours off), and a generous 10-metre white cable, giving you plenty of flexibility when choosing where to display it. Suitable for use indoors or out, this artificial tree has ample hanging space for you to decorate as you wish or you can enjoy it just as it is. Simple assembly required — the tree sections connect together (with built-in power sockets linking the lights automatically) and attach to the stand with 3 hand-tightened bolts, no power tools needed. The tree features 9 modes via the included remote: steady, fading, and flashing effects in warm white, multicolour, or both combined — plus an alternating mode. How are the lights powered? ## Features
- Fibre Optic LED Lights Tree
- 8 Changing Light Modes
- Illuminated Star Topper:
- Slim 8ft profile fits neatly in tighter spaces
- 350 multicolor LEDs give instant festive light
- 910 PVC tips create a fuller pine-style look
- Hinged sections make assembly quicker and easier
- Strong metal base helps support the finished tree

## Information
Create a festive centrepiece with this 8ft slim green pre-lit Christmas tree, designed to bring a natural pine-style look to your home with minimal effort. The pencil point tip design gives the tree a neat, elegant silhouette that suits rooms where space matters, while still providing a full seasonal appearance once decorated. Its slim shape makes it a practical choice for corners, hallways and living areas, helping you enjoy a traditional Christmas display without needing a wide footprint. Made from PVC with a strong metal base, this artificial tree is built for seasonal use and is intended to offer reliable support once assembled. The hinged construction helps the sections come together more easily, making setup more straightforward when preparing your festive décor. With 910 pencil point tips, the tree provides plenty of structure for baubles, ribbon and other decorations, allowing you to personalise the look to suit your style. This tree comes pre-lit with 350 multicolour LEDs, giving you instant festive brightness straight away. With eight lighting modes to choose from, including waves, sequential, slogs, chasing/flash, slow fade, twinkle/flash, steady on and combination, you can vary the look across the season depending on the occasion or mood. The lights help reduce the need for additional string lights and make it easier to achieve an eye-catching display quickly. The green finish supports a classic Christmas look that works well in both modern and traditional settings. Its slim profile also makes it easier to position in smaller rooms while still creating a noticeable decorative feature. Suitable for indoor display and sheltered outdoor occasions, this pre-lit artificial tree offers a reusable seasonal option that can be folded down after use and stored ready for future celebrations. Whether you are refreshing your family room décor or setting up a polished festive display elsewhere in the home, this 8ft slim pre-lit tree combines practical design with decorative impact. The sturdy metal base helps keep it steady once positioned, while the PVC tips provide a versatile surface for styling. With its balanced mix of size, lighting and ease of assembly, it offers a simple way to create a welcoming Christmas setting year after year.
Bring a touch of holiday spirit with this pre-lit Frosted Tips Modes Fibre Optic LED Pre-Lit tree, perfect for creating a warm and festive atmosphere in your home.

Our Aurora Winter Glow Christmas tree brings a magical, snow-kissed look to any living room, grand hallway or shop display. Delicately flocked in soft white for a frosted, just-fallen-snow finish, it's pre-lit with vibrant multi-colour and warm white LEDs offering 16 lighting functions - including twinkle effects and quick colour-flip transitions - making it a stunning centrepiece for the whole festive season. Simply unfold the branches and attach the tree to its stand. The sections connect via built-in power sockets, so lights link up automatically as you build the tree. A few bolts are hand-tightened during setup, no power tools required. Can I change the lighting effects? Yes, the tree features 16 modes via the included remote, covering steady, slow-fade, and twinkle effects in warm white, multicolour, and pastel, plus quick and slow colour-flip transitions and a demo mode that cycles through them all. How are the lights powered? The tree itself is mains-powered, simply plug in to enjoy. The remote control runs on a button cell battery (not included). Is it suitable for outdoor use? Designed for indoor use. For best results and safety, display in a dry, sheltered location. How is it delivered? Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery. Safety Information For indoor use only. Do not use if damaged or wet. Unplug by grasping the plug, not the cord. Keep cords, batteries, and small parts away from children and pets. The remote's button cell battery (not included) can cause serious internal injury if swallowed, sometimes within hours. If a battery is swallowed or you suspect ingestion, seek immediate medical attention. Ensure the battery compartment is securely closed at all times.

Used on its own or as part of a larger Christmas lighting arrangement, this decorative tree is designed to create a bright, elegant focal point with minimal setup.

- 1,870 flocked branch tips

## Information
Our Aurora Winter Glow Christmas tree brings a magical, snow-kissed look to any living room, grand hallway or shop display. Delicately flocked in soft white for a frosted, just-fallen-snow finish, it's pre-lit with vibrant multi-colour and warm white LEDs offering 16 lighting functions - including twinkle effects and quick colour-flip transitions - making it a stunning centrepiece for the whole festive season. What's included 1 x pre-lit flocked Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x Remote control Dimensions 6ft: approx. 180cm height, approx. 105cm at base, 1234 branch tips 7.5ft: approx. 228cm height, approx. 125cm at base, 1870 branch tips Good to know Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery Covered by a 1-year manufacturer warranty FAQs What sizes are available? This tree is available in two heights - 6ft and 7.5ft - so you can choose the best size for your space. Does it need assembly? Minimal assembly required. Simply unfold the branches and attach the tree to its stand. The sections connect via built-in power sockets, so lights link up automatically as you build the tree. A few bolts are hand-tightened during setup, no power tools required. Can I change the lighting effects? Yes, the tree features 16 modes via the included remote, covering steady, slow-fade, and twinkle effects in warm white, multicolour, and pastel, plus quick and slow colour-flip transitions and a demo mode that cycles through them all. How are the lights powered? The tree itself is mains-powered, simply plug in to enjoy. The remote control runs on a button cell battery (not included). Is it suitable for outdoor use? Designed for indoor use. For best results and safety, display in a dry, sheltered location. How is it delivered? Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery. Safety Information For indoor use only. Do not use if damaged or wet. Unplug by grasping the plug, not the cord. Keep cords, batteries, and small parts away from children and pets. The remote's button cell battery (not included) can cause serious internal injury if swallowed, sometimes within hours. If a battery is swallowed or you suspect ingestion, seek immediate medical attention. Ensure the battery compartment is securely closed at all times.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Built-in warm white LEDs save time at setup
- Eight light modes let you vary the festive mood
- Hinged branches make assembly quicker and easier
- PVC foliage gives a classic green pine appearance
- Metal stand helps support the tree once assembled
- Choose from 9 light modes, including waves, sequential, slo-glo, chasing or flash, slow fade, twinkle or flash, steady on and combination.
- Warm white LED lights create a traditional festive glow for indoor Christmas decorating.
- Hinged branches make assembly quicker and easier, helping the tree take shape with minimal setup.
- Mains-powered design with a 2m cable for convenient connection to a household socket.
- Fire retardant construction supports safer seasonal use.

## Information
Create a warm festive setting with this 12ft pre-lit green Alaskan pine artificial Christmas tree. Designed for homes that want a fuller seasonal centerpiece, it offers a natural look with plenty of space for ornaments and decorations. The PVC construction helps give the tree its classic artificial pine finish, while the hinged design supports straightforward assembly and shaping once the sections are in place. Built-in warm white LEDs are fitted to save time and reduce the need for separate light strings. The lighting includes multiple modes, giving you flexibility to adjust the display to suit your room and festive mood. Options include waves, sequential, slogs, chasing/flash, slow fade, twinkle/flash, steady on and combination, so you can vary the atmosphere through the season. The tree is supplied with a metal stand to help support it once assembled. As with many artificial trees of this type, arranging the branches after installation will help achieve the best appearance and create a fuller look. It also features 8 light modes so you can vary the appearance of your display to suit different occasions or moods. With 1341 tips, the tree is designed to offer a fuller decorative profile that supports a more natural-looking finish once assembled and dressed. Made from mixed materials including PE, PET and PVC, this artificial Christmas tree offers a durable construction for repeated seasonal use. Whether used as the main family tree or part of a larger Christmas display, this pre-lit Lapland fir provides an attractive and convenient way to decorate your home for the festive season. Its multicolor LED lighting adds lively color straight away, making it easier to create an eye-catching seasonal focal point without extra setup time. The combination of pre-lit convenience, multiple lighting effects and a traditional green finish makes this 8ft artificial Christmas tree a practical choice for festive decorating in living rooms, hallways or other indoor spaces where you want a standout Christmas feature.
Bring a touch of holiday spirit with this pre-lit Lapland Fir Multicolour LEDs tree, perfect for creating a warm and festive atmosphere in your home.

## Information
Create a festive centrepiece with this 8ft pre-lit Californian pine artificial Christmas tree, designed to bring a snowy winter look to your home or seasonal display. The snow-covered tips give the tree a frosted finish, while the warm white LEDs add a welcoming glow without the need for separate string lights. With 1382 tips, it provides a full and decorative shape that looks attractive whether styled with ornaments or left simple and illuminated on its own. The hinged branch design helps make assembly quicker and less demanding, so you can spend less time setting up and more time enjoying the finished display. Once the season is over, the same hinged construction also makes disassembly and storage more straightforward. A metal stand is included to help support the tree during use, and the PVC tips are made for repeated seasonal decorating year after year. At approximately 100cm at the widest point, this tree offers a substantial profile suited to living rooms, hallways, reception spaces or retail displays where a strong festive feature is needed. The integrated warm white LEDs are energy saving and have a long life of up to 50,000 hours, helping provide reliable seasonal lighting across many Christmases. Whether you prefer a traditional decorated tree or a snowy illuminated look, this artificial Californian pine offers a practical and eye-catching option for Christmas decorating. The combination of snow-covered leaves, realistic styling and integrated lighting creates an inviting festive atmosphere that works well in both home and shop settings. Use it as a ready-lit base for baubles, ribbons and garlands, or enjoy its wintry appearance as it comes. Built with convenience in mind, it brings together easy setup, durable materials and decorative impact in one seasonal tree. This artificial Christmas tree is intended for indoor festive use as part of your seasonal décor. Its full shape, snowy finish and pre-lit design make it easy to create an impressive display without buying additional lights separately. For customers looking for a classic green Christmas tree with a frosted effect and integrated illumination, this option delivers a balanced mix of style, practicality and repeated-use value.

## Features
- Pre-Lit 10ft Fraser Fir Christmas Tree for rooms with high ceilings
- 2,531 PE and PVC tips create a full, traditional tree silhouette
- 770 warm white and multi-colour LEDs with colour switch function
- Mains powered with built-in six-hour timer and 5m green cable

## Information
Bring festive grandeur to high-ceilinged rooms with the Pre-Lit 10ft Fraser Fir Artificial Christmas Tree from Christow. Ideal for spacious homes, entrance halls, and lobbies, its towering height and traditional silhouette create a spectacular centrepiece. A combination of moulded PE and classic PVC tips gives the foliage a dense, natural look, while 770 pre-wrapped LEDs save you the effort of adding separate lights. Change from warm white to multi-coloured LEDs, then explore 11 light settings for a magical display. Switchable Colours & Light Effects Switch the LEDs from warm white to multi-coloured to create your dream display. From soft fades and twinkles to bold colour-changing bursts, choose from a variety of light effects, with a built-in memory function remembering your last setting. Automatic Six-Hour Timer Mains powered with a 5m green cable for flexible display, the tree features a built-in timer function for hassle-free festive lighting. Once activated, the LEDs automatically illuminate at the same time each evening before switching off six hours later. Five-Section Hinged Construction Five sections help make this towering tree easier to handle and assemble during setup. After slotting them together, lower the hinged branches gently into position, then spread and fluff the tips to achieve even coverage from top to bottom. Wide Metal Support Stand Supplied with a sturdy metal stand and silver eyebolts for secure attachment and stable display all season long. Coloured green to blend naturally with the foliage, the stand also features rubber feet to help protect hard floors from marks and scratches. Bring the magic of fireworks to your garden at the touch of a button. Create a stunning light display in your garden with this App-Controlled Firework Tree. Each individual firework has 20 stems with 7 LED's in each so a total of 140 LED's on each firework!

products.sourceDescription:
## Features


## Information
Bring the magic of a winter woodland into your home with the Christow Nordmann Fir Artificial Christmas Tree. Layered, uneven branches, tapered with gaps between them, capture the sparse, natural look of a real winter woodland fir. Lifelike PE and classic PVC tips add depth, fullness, and natural charm. The tree comes in three sections with hinged branches, twist-and-lock poles, and a sturdy metal stand for easy setup and styling. Instructions are included to guide you every step of the way. Start by securing the base section into the stand and pulling down the branches. Then repeat with the middle and top, locking each section into place and shaping the branches as you go. Crafted with a blend of moulded PE and traditional PVC tips, the tree has a natural woodland look with lifelike texture and detail. While the PE tips add depth and definition, the PVC tips help fill out the branches to replicate a real fir tree.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Magical winter centrepiece
- Luxury snow flocked tips
- Hinged branch construction
- Green metal stand included
- Easy to assemble

## Information
Bring the magic of a winter woodland into your home with the Christow Nordmann Fir Artificial Christmas Tree. Layered, uneven branches, tapered with gaps between them, capture the sparse, natural look of a real winter woodland fir. Lifelike PE and classic PVC tips add depth, fullness, and natural charm. The tree comes in three sections with hinged branches, twist-and-lock poles, and a sturdy metal stand for easy setup and styling. Instructions are included to guide you every step of the way. Start by securing the base section into the stand and pulling down the branches. Then repeat with the middle and top, locking each section into place and shaping the branches as you go. Crafted with a blend of moulded PE and traditional PVC tips, the tree has a natural woodland look with lifelike texture and detail. While the PE tips add depth and definition, the PVC tips help fill out the branches to replicate a real fir tree.

## Features
- Designed to hide those unsightly stands and cables
- Collapses for easy storage when not in use
- Medium white wash in colour
- The perfect skirt for your tree
- 3-part tree skirt for easy assembly

## Information
Make a statement this Christmas year with this deluxe Samuel Alexander rattan affect Christmas tree skirt in whitewash. This medium stylish tree skirt sits around the base of the tree and will compliment the appearance and help artificial trees to look more realistic by hiding the metal or plastic stands. Tree skirt's primary function in the past would have been to protect the floor from wax candle drippings and fallen needles. Made from a metal frame and split willow body, these tree skirts come in 3 section pieces which clip together to create the full collar and easily dismantle which allows for easy storage until next year. ## Information
Bring a classic finishing touch to your Christmas display with this 5ft Christmas tree skirt base cover. Designed with a 3D reindeer theme, it helps create a warm seasonal feel around the base of your tree while giving presents a neat and decorative place to sit. The skirt is made to sit underneath the tree, helping complete the overall look of your festive setup in a simple and effective way. It is also practical for natural trees, as it can help catch fallen needles and small shavings, keeping the surrounding area looking tidier throughout the season. The design includes a slit for easier placement around the trunk, so you can position it without needing to lift the tree. That makes it a convenient option when decorating at home, especially if you want to add a polished finish without extra effort. Its decorative style works well in living rooms, hallways and other indoor spaces where you want to build a traditional Christmas atmosphere. As well as being visually appealing, this tree skirt is a useful part of your seasonal decorating routine. It can help define the space beneath your tree and make gift presentation look more organised. Whether your display is simple or more elaborate, the reindeer motif adds recognisable festive charm that suits family settings and classic holiday decor. The product is supplied as one Christmas tree skirt base cover and is intended for indoor seasonal decoration. It offers an easy way to enhance the appearance of your tree while supporting a tidy and coordinated look at floor level. Use it as part of your main Christmas arrangement or combine it with other decorations to create a welcoming festive focal point in your home. With its 5ft size and traditional style, it provides an attractive base detail that complements many Christmas tree displays without overpowering them.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Christmas Tree Skirt
- Discover Cozy & Festive Christmas Tree Skirts
- The hexagonal design creates a neat, structured tree base, while the distressed white finish adds rustic character to your Christmas display
- Made from wood, this decorative collar helps conceal the tree stand and creates a cleaner, more polished presentation
- The distressed white finish brings a rustic, farmhouse-inspired feel to traditional or contemporary Christmas decor
- The lightweight, collapsible construction is easy to handle and helps save storage space between Christmas seasons
- A practical alternative to a fabric tree skirt, it helps cover the tree base without shifting or wrinkling
- The distressed white finish brings a rustic, farmhouse-inspired feel to traditional or contemporary Christmas décor.
- The structured hexagonal shape provides a smart alternative to a traditional fabric tree skirt.
- Suitable for use with both artificial and real Christmas trees.
- Tool-free assembly makes setup simple, while the collapsible design folds flat for compact storage after the festive season.
- The fire-retardant design is suitable for use with Christmas lights and decorations when used responsibly.

## Information
Give your Christmas tree a neat, finished look with this wooden hexagon tree collar. Designed to sit around the base of the tree, it helps conceal the stand while adding rustic warmth to your festive décor. The burnt wood finish, decorative reindeer and Merry Christmas detailing create a traditional seasonal style. Made from sturdy wood, the collar is designed for repeated use across multiple Christmas seasons. It folds down for easier storage and assembles with latch hinges and small pins. Measuring 31.5 inches in bottom diameter, 26 inches in top diameter and 9.8 inches in height, it is suitable for larger tree stands. Fire-retardant construction supports safer use around Christmas lights and decorations. Not suitable for children under 36 months.

## Features
- Light up tree skirt
- 600 LED microlights
- Suitable for indoor or outdoor under cover use
- Timer - 6 hours on/18 hours off
- UK transformer plug
- 8 multi-functions including static
- 5m cable
- Dimensions: 50cm x 71cm x 28cm
- 1 year warranty

## Information
Enhance the base of your Christmas tree with the Pre-Lit Christmas Gold Laser Light-Up Tree Skirt, a dazzling festive accessory that adds warmth, elegance, and sparkle to your holiday décor. Measuring 71cm in diameter, this beautifully crafted tree skirt is adorned with 600 warm white LED micro-lights, carefully positioned to create a radiant, twinkling glow that brings instant festive magic to any setting. Its luxurious gold finish adds a sophisticated touch, making it a stunning addition to your indoor or outdoor display. Designed for flexibility, the tree skirt can be enjoyed both inside and outside, allowing you to create a cohesive festive scene throughout your home or garden. It comes with a generous 5-metre cable, giving you the freedom to position it exactly where you need. A transformer is supplied for use with the lights, but it must always remain indoors to ensure safe and reliable operation. The tree skirt features 8 different lighting functions, from a gentle, steady glow to a lively, sparkling twinkle, so you can effortlessly create the perfect festive atmosphere. A built-in 6-hour timer adds convenience, automatically illuminating your tree skirt for a set period each day while saving energy and allowing you to enjoy the display without constant attention. Dimensions: 50cm (W) x 28cm (H) x 71cm (D). PLEASE NOTE: Tree not included, skirt only.

## Information

A pair of premium quality, highly desirable artificial spiral boxwood topiary trees measuring 90cm/3ft in height. Extremely lifelike and realistic looking, from a short distance it's hard to believe they are not real. Easy and carefree alternative to real plants. Perfect if you don't want the hassle or have the time to care for living plants. They look absolutely fantastic either side of doorways, on the balcony or patio. Also outside shop fronts, offices and receptions as well as bars & restaurants. For an extra stylish look, plant the trees up into large planters or tubs. Fill the bottom with a heavy material such as sand or stones to prevent the tree being blown over in strong winds. Then fill with a material that can be compacted such as ordinary soil up to the level you want the tree to sit in the planter. Place the tree in the middle and fill to the top and compact hard around the plastic pot and the base of the tree. The core is a metal pole which the plastic foliage spirals around. The metal core is not visible as the foliage is thick and covers the pole entirely. The metal core provides a strong solid centre for the tree, making it robust and durable. Supplied in a black plastic pot with concrete filling to stabilize the base of the tree. The pot can be removed simply by pulling out the metal centre from its housing in the pot. Please note the trees are packed in cardboard cartons for maximum protection. The trees are lying down flat in the boxes which can cause the plastic foliage to be compressed and out of shape. The perfect shape can be regained by gently pulling and fluffing the foliage back into shape. Sold as a pair (2 trees per carton).
